fields.title: Parameter name
fields.description: The parameter name is supposed to be unique, but this is not enforced. In case multiple Workflow Output nodes define the same parameter name, KNIME will make them unique by appending the node's node ID, e.g., "output-table" becomes "output-table-7".

fields.title: Description
fields.description: The description for the workflow output parameter describing the purpose of the parameter.
